text:
Anna (Partnerships): ok team — we need to lock the regional catalog rollout timeline + SI SDK handoff this week. proposing EU cutover Fri 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC, APAC Mon 2026-04-05 02:00 UTC. canary first, full cutover within 4h. thoughts?
Devin (Eng): EU time works for infra team. need staging slot tomorrow (Thu) to validate billing SKU mapping and listing artifacts.
Leah (Product): confirm we have localized landing pages for DE, FR, and JP by Thu EOD. marketing copy needs review. also: which SKU will be public vs private preview?
Jenna (Marketing): embargo windows? we need at least 48h for EU press embargo and 72h for APAC partners/localization signoff. blog draft in draft-google-drive link (sent in DM).
Mike (Sales): partner comms ready salvo — need partner logos + legal thumbprints from HW vendors by Wed. also asking SI partners for integration readiness checklist. Omar, can your team certify by Thu?
Omar (SI): SI team can complete basic certification by Thu evening if we hand off the SDK today. we still need the sample Terraform + container image for on-prem validation.
Devin (Eng): putting the SDK bundle and terraform sample into s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/179111 today. will post link here when uploaded. also need to freeze model variants for the listing (quantized v1 + fp16 fallback).
Anna (Partnerships): action: @Devin upload SDK + TF sample now. @Omar schedule cert slot Thu 16:00 UTC. @Jenna confirm embargo messaging and send blog timeline. @Mike collect logos/legal. @Leah lock page copy.
LegalBot: Reminder: for joint announcements with partners we need signoff on co-marketing terms and trademark usage before any public mention. Suggested lead time: EU 2 business days, APAC 3 business days.
Jenna (Marketing): ack. will route co-marketing terms to legal via PRD and include partner contact list.
Devin (Eng): quick check: canary plan below — please confirm rollback window.
```
canary_plan:
  stage_1: 5% traffic -> 30m
  stage_2: 20% traffic -> 1h
  stage_3: 50% traffic -> 2h
  full: 100% -> if metrics ok after stage_3
rollback: immediate to previous model variant if error rate > 3% or latency > 2x SLA
```
Leah (Product): that looks good. also need metrics guardrails: p50/p90 latency, token cost per request, and error rate. add a short smoke test checklist for landing page CTAs.
Mike (Sales): FYI partner A (HW vendor) requested a staging listing preview by Wed AM to prepare their marketplace collateral. can we provide a staging URL?
Devin (Eng): yes — staging catalog URL will be https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/catalog/region-eu/179111 — will populate once artifacts uploaded.
Omar (SI): small ask — CI test credentials for on-prem runs. can we create a short-lived token for cert runs?
Devin (Eng): will create tokens scoped to SI-cert role, expires +72h. posting creds to secure channel not here.
Anna (Partnerships): risk callouts: 1) localized copy slipping (impact: APAC delay) 2) partner legal delays (impact: embargo shifts) 3) billing SKU mismatch (impact: revenue reporting). contingency: staging hold + rolling partial publish per region.
Jenna (Marketing): propose backup: soft-launch microsite (no press) for regions where legal isn't cleared, full announce for cleared regions.
Leah (Product): agree. also set a feature-flag to hide partner-specific logos until legal signoff.
Mike (Sales): I'm going to ping partner A and B now for logos and co-marketing contracts. will update here. :+1:
Devin (Eng): uploaded SDK bundle and terraform sample: s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/179111/sdk-v1.zip and s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/179111/terraform-sample.tar.gz
Omar (SI): got the artifact links. scheduling cert window Thu 16:00 UTC. will report pass/fail in this thread.
Jenna (Marketing): blog draft sent to Anna + Legal via Google Drive. embargo window requested: EU 2026-04-02 06:00 UTC public, APAC 2026-04-05 00:00 UTC public. please confirm legal ack.
LegalBot: Noted. awaiting signed co-marketing agreements for partner A and B. will confirm when signed.
Anna (Partnerships): next sync Thu 17:00 UTC to confirm green for EU staging and SI cert. if all good, we proceed with canary Fri 08:00 UTC. thanks everyone. :shipit:
